g.text: 每阶段一次软交互 / One Soft Cross block per stage
Depths [2, 2, 4, 2] • AS6 directional modeling • MLFM skip fusion • Deep RHDB / shallow ResNet decoder
双分支层次编码器 / Dual-branch encoder
Bottleneck: Conv 3×3, stride 2 → GN → GELU → ConvBlock
Output logits · N × K × H × W
C→S | C→S | C→S→S→S | C→S C = Soft Cross block; S = Self block
10 dual-branch blocks · 80 independent AS6 instances · 16 learned exchange scalars · MLFM runs once at each stage end
A/B features continue to the next encoder stage. S1–S4 feed the decoder. Spatial ratios assume H and W divisible by 64; batch omitted internally.
